tools.name: request_signnow_demo_dialog
tools.description: Request a signNow sales demo using the demo request dialog on this page. Fills in the dialog form with the prospect's details for the person to review and submit.

email.description: The prospect's work email address, used by sales to get in touch

phone.description: The prospect's phone number, including country code

company_name.description: The name of the company the prospect works for

job_title.description: The prospect's job title or role at their company

users.description: Number of people at the company who would use signNow

question.description: Any question, context or requirement the prospect wants to share with sales

tools.name: search_signnow_features
tools.description: Search signNow's eSignature product features by name or capability, for example "bulk send", "reusable templates" or "audit trail". Returns matching features with their description and page URL.

query.description: What to search for, for example "bulk send", "reusable templates" or "audit trail".

tools.name: search_signnow_form_templates
tools.description: Search signNow's library of ready-to-use PDF form templates by name or topic, for example "W-9", "lease agreement" or "medical release". Returns matching templates with their title, description and page URL.

query.description: What to search for, for example "W-9", "lease agreement" or "medical release".
